purpose: Unit-boundary regression cases for human review/audit development; not gameplay authority.

cases.input: 5000 infantry, loadout A; change only 1000 to loadout B
cases.invalid_result: one 5000-person unit containing two intended loadout standards

cases.input: 5000 infantry + 2000 archers split across two commanders
cases.valid_result: separate infantry units and archer units; commanders may each control several units
cases.invalid_result: a unit containing infantry and archers

cases.valid_result: support remains targetable/casualty-bearing but adds no default assault frontage
cases.invalid_result: support headcount automatically increases line combat power

cases.input: one unit split into five under same commander
cases.valid_result: same people and real frontage; greater direct command burden unless delegated
cases.invalid_result: free frontage, healing, equipment, experience, or command capacity

cases.input: one 5000-person unit split neutrally to 4000 + 1000 with no selection criteria
cases.valid_result: both children initially inherit parent aggregate mean/spread; integer injuries/equipment categories allocate by deterministic largest remainder; no child is secretly elite
cases.invalid_result: AI rerolls child averages or concentrates veterans without an explicit selection action

cases.input: two compatible same-type units with different means/spreads merge
cases.valid_result: personnel-weighted mean and pooled population variance; categorical quantities sum; cohesion cannot improve for free
cases.invalid_result: simple average ignoring unit size, reset stats, or choose better source values

cases.input: commander comfort 10000 personnel/8 slots; 15000 personnel in 10 units; delegate 5000 in 4 units to one subordinate
cases.valid_result: superior direct load 10000 personnel + 6 leaf units + 1 subordinate node = 7 slots; subordinate 5000/4; all ownership classes share these limits
cases.invalid_result: personal and assigned troops use separate budgets or subordinate descendants still count as superior direct personnel
